assumptions: Same-name current ranked IDs form a possible output identity family, not an equal quality distribution. Use the verified CraftingQualityID join for routing.
Literal family names and native source recipe/target must agree. Unknown named outputs never substitute an unrelated baseline primary material.
Native-essence family mappings remain lower-confidence possible pools; the perk text does not enumerate loot IDs.
Bound material identities do not grant recipe/action eligibility, bypass an unlock, remove event conditions, or create observed sample counts.
When a prior transfers to a fixed family, its unit total stays fixed across the family rather than applying the full amount independently to every ranked ID.

Named-family rows are working named-outcome/discovery metrics with unresolved item identity and no invented item price. Their presence does not mean an exact loot distribution or ItemID has been verified.
Renamed seed families are matched by native region and unique infusion adjective, with explicit current native item IDs.
Creature-specific pools preserve target restrictions. Family identity does not identify individual target shares or a drop rate.
All quantity confidence remains zero; these identity upgrades do not upgrade existing numerical coefficients or model confidence.
